from_quote: as the age of a representative
rationale: Names "the age of a representative" among the provisions other writers have praised; only this clause sets a representative's age.
to_quote: No Person shall be a Representative who shall not have attained to the Age of twenty five Years

from_quote: as the age of a representative, of the president, &c.
rationale: Names the age "of the president" among the provisions other writers have praised; only this clause sets the President's age.

from_quote: have their negroes represented in the legislature
rationale: Says the southern states will "have their negroes represented in the legislature," naming the counting of enslaved persons in apportioning representatives, which only this clause provides.
to_quote: three fifths of all other Persons
